Consent to Participate: Platform Use and Communication Survey

This survey is part of a research project at BRAC University studying how students and teachers manage communication across LMS platforms (e.g., Moodle, Google Classroom) and messaging apps (e.g., WhatsApp, Discord). It takes approximately 5-8 minutes.

Participation is completely voluntary. You may stop at any time by closing the form; partial responses will not be used.

This survey does not collect your name, email, student ID, or any other identifying information—your responses are fully anonymous and cannot be traced back to you.
There are no known risks to participating.

If you have questions about this research, you may contact [md.shamim.mia@g.bracu.ac.bd, israt.jahan.khan1@g.bracu.ac.bd, jamiul.haque.dipto@g.bracu.ac.bd].

An ideal LMS should be a single, fast workspace that eliminates extra messaging apps.

Such as

Unified Messaging: Built-in chat for announcements, Q&A, and group work.

Master Calendar: Auto-synced deadlines, exams, and schedules across all courses.

Global Search: Instant search across all PDFs, slides, and notices.

Task Dashboard: Easy tracking of upcoming assignments and grades.

Smart Notifications: Custom alerts and quiet hours to prevent overload.
